scope: publicly verified bibliographic/abstract-level evidence registry — NOT numerical benchmarks
rule: Never load observed values into prediction solver or infer correspondence C from phase labels and unrelated lattice metrics.

sources.measured: EBSD of Cu-12.55 wt% Al-4.84 wt% Ni: 2H variant ORs; A-C/B-D {121}_2H twin mirror and A-D/B-C {101}_2H twin mirror; basal planes from parent {110} and [010]_2H from parent <001>
sources.missing_for_blind_3d: specimen-matched complete metric, explicit C, per-interface measured 3D Cartesian normals, uncertainty, parent/product sample orientations and preregistration

sources.citation: U. Sari and I. Aksoy, J. Alloys Compd. 417 (2006) 138-142
sources.measured: SEM/TEM and diffraction, Cu-11.92 wt% Al-3.78 wt% Ni after two different heat treatments; heat treatment influences 2H versus 18R; beta1' classified as modified monoclinic M18R
sources.missing_for_blind_3d: matched twin/habit normals, measured ORs, C, matched parent and product metrics and angular uncertainty

sources.citation: M. L. Nó, D. Caillard and J. San Juan, Acta Mater. 57 (2009) 1004-1014
sources.measured: TEM study describes nine experimentally investigated habit planes and ORs using diffraction and 3D dense-plane matching; abstract does not provide the per-plane measured numerical values
sources.missing_for_blind_3d: original tables/diffraction indexing, each specimen identification, phase, parent and daughter metric settings, uncertainty and C

sources.citation: N. Zárubová et al., ESOMAT (2009), in-situ TEM stress-induced transformations in CuAlNi
sources.measured: In situ TEM observations of austenite-to-2H at lower applied stress and austenite-to-18R at higher stress; interface morphology investigated
sources.missing_for_blind_3d: 3D specimen-specific indexed planes with uncertainties, correspondences, full transformation OR and metrics

distinctions: 2H gamma1' is an orthorhombic martensite structure in the stated conventional setting; do not infer from composition alone.
CuAlNi beta1' can have modified monoclinic 18R stacking; a reduced 6M crystallographic representation must not be identified by name alone with a measured conventional 18R cell.
Observed 2D traces provide only surface intersections and do not determine full 3D habit/twin plane inclinations.
A phase-indexing or diffraction identification paper is not necessarily a quantified twin/habit geometry benchmark.
